PRIVACY

Your information, in context.

Updated 15 November 2026

What this website does

HarnessLoop is an informational website with synthetic demonstrations. It has no user accounts, payment processing or file uploads. Service scope and data handling for a client project are agreed separately before any project data is provided.

A brief stays in your browser

The brief tool generates text in the current page. It does not submit your input to a server, save it in cookies or local storage, or retain it after refresh or a language switch. Copying uses your browser clipboard. The email link opens your mail application with a draft; you decide whether to send it.

Local storage and hosting

This website stores nothing in your browser: no cookies and no local storage. Chinese and English pages have stable URLs; use the language link in the header to switch, and in-site links keep your language. This website does not include analytics trackers, advertising scripts, third-party fonts or an external form service. Hosting providers may process network and request information to serve and secure the website. For Vercel’s practices, see Vercel’s privacy notice.

The demo video

The walkthrough video on the home page is hosted on GitHub (github.com), not on this website. The still image and player appear first; the video itself is requested from GitHub only when you press play, and GitHub then receives your IP address for that request. A link under the video opens the same file on GitHub.

When you email

Messages you choose to send to contact@harnessloop.ai pass through email providers and are available to the recipient to review and respond to your enquiry. Email is separate from the local brief tool. Please do not send medical records, personal sensitive information, credentials or confidential client data. Agree a suitable data-sharing process before supplying project materials.

Questions and requests

For questions about this website or information you have sent, contact contact@harnessloop.ai. Include only the information needed to identify your enquiry.
